source.note: Generated by the agent from the Figma variables and text, paint and effect styles (MCP read). Never edit by hand: change Figma, read again, run node tools/gen-tokens.mjs.

variables.name: bg/page
variables.description: Page background and bottom stop of the page gradient (Background/Page). Contrast reference surface.

variables.name: surface/glass
variables.description: Frosted glass fill for cards, sheets and round buttons. Use through paint Surface/Glass + effect Glass.

variables.name: surface/2
variables.description: Opaque raised surface: nested panels, input fields, bar tracks.

variables.name: surface/tint
variables.description: Accent-tinted glass: user chat bubble, log chip, selected states.

variables.name: border/glass
variables.description: Hairline border (1 px) on glass surfaces.

variables.name: border/line
variables.description: Dividers, the timeline guide and other 1 px lines.

variables.name: text/primary
variables.description: Primary text: titles, body and every number.

variables.name: text/muted
variables.description: Secondary text: labels, descriptions, captions.

variables.name: text/dim
variables.description: Tertiary text: timestamps, placeholders, units. Still clears 4.5:1 on every surface.

variables.name: icon/primary
variables.description: Default icon color.

variables.name: icon/muted
variables.description: Secondary icon color (inactive actions, composer icons).

variables.name: accent/default
variables.description: Aero accent (blue Light, cyan Dark): CTA base, active timeline node, selected border, links. Accent only, never a large fill behind text other than accent/on.

variables.name: accent/on
variables.description: Text and icons on accent/default (CTA label).

variables.name: status/good
variables.description: Within budget, done, positive remaining.

variables.name: status/bad
variables.description: Over budget, errors, destructive actions.

variables.name: macro/protein
variables.description: Semantic protein color (P): macro bars, chips and values.

variables.name: macro/carbs
variables.description: Semantic carbohydrate color (C): macro bars, chips and values.

variables.name: macro/fat
variables.description: Semantic fat color (G): macro bars, chips and values.

variables.name: shadow/glass
variables.description: Drop shadow color of the effect style Glass.

variables.name: bg/top
variables.description: Top stop of the page gradient (Background/Page): sky (Light), ocean surface (Dark). Never behind body text without glass.

variables.name: bg/mid
variables.description: Middle stop of the page gradient (Background/Page).

variables.name: sheen/start
variables.description: Top stop of the glass sheen (paint Surface/Glass, 0%).

variables.name: sheen/end
variables.description: Bottom stop of the glass sheen (paint Surface/Glass, 40%), transparent.

variables.name: overlay/scrim
variables.description: Scrim behind a modal sheet: dims the screen underneath. Light: bg/page Dark at 40 %; Dark: black at 60 %.

variables.name: status/bad-tint
variables.description: Background tint of an over-the-meta element (Meta excedida pill, over node): status/bad at 12 % (Light) / 16 % (Dark).

variables.name: status/on-bad
variables.description: Text and icons on a status/bad fill (Excluir e pular in chatSD): white in both themes.

variables.name: surface/selected
variables.description: Selected chat row (chatCP, ADR-048): band behind the whole row, accent family at 30 %; darker than the page in Light, lighter in Dark. Text on it keeps WCAG AA. The selected bubble sits on an opaque bg/page backing (the band never shows through the glass) and carries the border/selected ring, the 3:1 state cue.

variables.name: border/selected
variables.description: Ring (2 px, inside) of a selected chat bubble (chatCP, ADR-048): the WCAG 1.4.11 state cue, at least 3:1 against the bubble and against surface/selected in both themes.

variables.name: radius/card
variables.description: Cards, bubbles, option cards.

variables.name: radius/sheet
variables.description: Bottom sheets and dialogs (top corners).

variables.name: radius/pill
variables.description: Pills: CTA, chips, composer, bars.

variables.name: space/xs
variables.description: Spacing 4: icon to label, tight inline gaps.

variables.name: space/sm
variables.description: Spacing 8: inside chips and rows.

variables.name: space/md
variables.description: Spacing 16: card padding, list gaps.

variables.name: space/lg
variables.description: Spacing 24: between blocks.

variables.name: space/xl
variables.description: Spacing 32: between sections.

variables.name: space/margin
variables.description: Screen side margin 20.

variables.name: size/bar
variables.description: Height of progress and macro bars.

variables.name: blur/glass
variables.description: Background blur radius of the effect style Glass (API 31+; opaque fallback below).

variables.name: motion/fast
variables.description: Duration 150 ms: press feedback, chip and toggle changes.

variables.name: motion/base
variables.description: Duration 250 ms: default enter and content changes.

variables.name: motion/slow
variables.description: Duration 400 ms: sheets, screen transitions, timeline progress.

variables.name: easing/standard
variables.description: Easing standard = cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1). Elements that move or resize on screen.

variables.name: easing/emphasized
variables.description: Easing emphasized = cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1). Entering elements: sheets, new chat messages.

variables.name: easing/exit
variables.description: Easing exit = cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 1, 1). Elements leaving the screen.

paintStyles.name: Background/Page
paintStyles.description: Page background gradient, top to bottom.

paintStyles.name: Surface/Glass
paintStyles.description: Glass fill plus the top sheen. Used with the effect style Glass.

paintStyles.name: Gloss/Button
paintStyles.description: White gloss over an accent or macro fill (CTA, bars, radio, send).

effectStyles.name: Glass
effectStyles.description: Backdrop blur plus soft drop shadow of glass surfaces.
